ambiguities.text: Application logic must determine appropriate limits at runtime—no specification of what constitutes 'appropriate'
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'appropriate' means limits that prevent memory exhaustion while supporting expected maximum sizes for the specific context (e.g., validator count).

ambiguities.text: Requirements for maintaining backward-compatible verifier logic are mentioned but not formally specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume verifiers must support both legacy merkleization and ProgressiveContainer merkleization during transition periods.

ambiguities.text: 'Best to apply...before merkleization would be broken' lacks precise fork-selection criteria
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume migration should occur at the first fork where any structural change would break existing merkle proofs.

ambiguities.text: Specifics of 'incrementally construct[ing]' new Validator entries undefined
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume incremental construction means processing Validator entries one at a time rather than bulk operations.
